question: Does OpenHands still offer a hosted OpenHands Cloud with a free allowance, or has the vendor moved every plan to self-hosted, and should the record be re-pointed, marked self_hosted, or split?
why: openhands.dev/pricing, read on 2026-10-30, lists Agent Canvas (free to self-host), Teams ($500/month, self-hosted, 30-day trial) and Enterprise with every deployment column self-hosted, while the docs still describe an OpenHands Cloud UI with a Billing tab for credits; neither page states a hosted free amount.
